issues: scene_002: Assigning the voice to Jesus Christ is plausible from broader context but not identified in these supplied verses; keep the speaker unspecified. The visual inference that the people listen is reasonable, but the text does not describe their actions during this speech.

The explicit-facts wording says Zenos and Zenock testified particularly concerning the remnant; the verse says their testimony concerned “these things” because they testified particularly concerning “us, who are the remnant of their seed.”
The narrator identity as Mormon is not established by these supplied verses; it may be supported elsewhere, but is unspecified here.
